## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation you're experiencing. What are you trying to do that NSCK doesn't currently support?

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen or the feature you'd like added.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Which Subsystem Would Be Affected?

- [ ] VSA foundation (`nsck/python/core/vsa/`)
- [ ] Episodic / Semantic memory
- [ ] Reasoning (GlobalWorkspace, CausalGraph, STRIPS Planner, Analogy)
- [ ] Language (SRL, TextKnowledgeLearner, NLG)
- [ ] Perception / SNN layer
- [ ] Rust accelerator (`nsck/rust_vsa`, `nsck/rust_snn`)
- [ ] AI model layer (`nsck_ai_model/`)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI / Tooling
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or screenshots that support your feature request.
